component.name: Tinta Mono
component.summary: Fast Markdown and Mermaid viewer and editor

description.p: Tinta Mono opens Markdown documents instantly and renders Mermaid diagrams, math, tables and code in place, with its source editor beside a live preview. It is a cross-platform fork of Tinta by oipoistar, with Linux support, Mermaid through merman, and programmer-friendly defaults.

ul.li: Mermaid diagrams drawn in place, with labels sized in the theme's own face
Tabs that tear off into windows and move between them
Paste screenshots into a document's assets folder, or inline
Export to HTML, PDF and Word
Twelve themes, plus your own in themes.ini
Windows, Vim and Emacs keyboard shortcuts
